_comment: Human names for the MISSION board (proposal T1.8). Read ONLY by the cockpit's
view layer - cockpit.ps1, mission_view.py - and never by the engine, so this
file cannot change what runs, what is cached, or what anything costs.
It exists because taskgraph `Node` is extra="forbid": there is nowhere in a
flow file to put a name aimed at a person, and adding one would be a format
change to a surface the proposal deliberately does not touch. A sidecar keeps
the DE tier mechanical - this is a file lookup, not a narrated branch - and
leaves every flow written to date verifying unchanged.
Naming: <flow-file-stem>.labels.json, beside the flow. The run dir's own
flow.labels.json wins if present, so relabelling later cannot rewrite what a
Write what the step MEANS to the person waiting on it, not what it does
technically. Keep it under 34 characters or it is truncated in the pane.
`tiers` sets the approval tier (T3.3): routine | standard | irreversible. A
tier changes the banner and what evidence is required. It NEVER skips the
human - a flow author must not be able to remove them by declaring a tier.
